ENGAGEMENT APPROACH FY19 INTERACTIONS:
We engage with suppliers through quarterly business 
reviews and allocate points to their performance scores 
commensurate with their efforts to participate in social 
and environmental initiatives. Through the RBA, we analyze 
suppliers’ self-assessment documentation and request 
periodic audits. 
We reach out to suppliers directly on issues related to 
product compliance and conflict minerals.
